sources.snippet: indri-.1-124m-tts is a novel, ultra-small, and lightweight TTS model based on the transformer architecture. It models audio as tokens and can generate high-quality audio with consistent style cloning of the speaker.

sources.snippet: Using our self hosted service option, on RTX6000Ada NVIDIA GPU the model can achieve speeds up to 400 toks/s (4s of audio generation per s) and under 20ms time to first token for the 124m model. On RTX6000Ada, it can support a batch size of ~1000 sequences with full context length of 1024 tokens Supports voice cloning with small prompts (<5s).
